id: title:jakesciotto:match replay usage by jsonb containment instead of integer cast

review.posthog_relevance: Fixes a query compatibility and correctness issue in the session recording feature, specifically the `session_recording_linked_flag__contains` check, by replacing an explicit integer cast with a PostgreSQL JSONB containment check. This prevents potential database errors when the stored ID is not an integer and aligns the query with the expected JSONB structure.
review.reason: The change replaces an explicit cast to IntegerField with a PostgreSQL JSONB containment check using `JSONObject` and `JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT`. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement. P1.F1.H2 removes the cast and P1.F2.H1 updates the query to use the new JSONB containment syntax. P1.F1.H1 adds the necessary import.
